name: Roulette Hero
description:
About This Game

Roulette Hero combines the mechanics of Luck Be A Landlord and Slay the Spire, and is a brand new form of deck-building roguelite strategy game.

Pull the lever, spin the roulette and trigger some killer combos! Each pull of the lever is full of surprises. Will you start a chain reaction, deal crushingly high damage, demolish your enemy and come out on top?

Craft the Ultimate Synergy

Build your dream team of extraordinary animal companions

Position them wisely and combine their abilities

Unleash devastating combos to wipe out the battlefield

Every Spin is a New Adventure

Multiple player character and swappable levers, all with unique special abilities

13 animal types, 100+ animal tiles to arrange on your board

100+ power-up cartridges to mix and match

Each spin could turn the tide... or send you scrambling for a comeback!

See You at the Top, Challenger!

Fight your way through all 20 difficulty levels

Compete for the top spot on the leaderboard

Tinker Around in Steam Workshop

Subscribe to mods you're interested in

Add a new quirky character, thrilling power-up cartridge, or a crazy synergy

See where your imagination takes you!

*There are currently playable mods on Steam Workshop
short_desc: Roulette Hero is a strategic roguelike deckbuilder where you assemble animal companions to defeat towering mechanical beasts. Line up the perfect squad on your roulette wheel, spin to activate your animals' abilities, trigger game-changing synergies, and turn the tide of battle!
